text:
mira: kicking off deploy for service=runtime-inference v2.2. Plan is quiet window midnight -> muted ramping of featureflag llm_v2. Steps: set ff=0 -> 0.05 (canary 10 hosts) -> 0.25 -> 1 over 30m with telemetry gates. pin model version to v1.9 for legacy traffic. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-23/v2.2

samir: ack. can you add the deploybot holdpoint at the first gate? if error-rate > 2% or p95 latency increases > 25% -> rollback. Also request to set a soft-drain for session affinity for 10m. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary group A (10 hosts). featureflag llm_v2 -> 0.05. telemetry hooks: /ops/telemetry/deploy/7623456789 live.

mira: thanks. sampling evals enabled (prompt-set: smoke_v2). if quality regressions > 1.5% attrition we abort.

evan: quick Q: are we pinning routing for enterprise customers? we should keep them on v1.9 until final gate.

mira: yes - enterprise-cohort pinned to model=v1.9 via routing-pin rule until gate passes.

samir: adding the rollback command here for quick use:
```
# rollback to previous flag state and drain new instances
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/llm_v2 -d '{"value":0}'
deploybot action: drain --group canaryA --timeout 600
```

deploybot: telemetry: canary A metrics: error_rate=0.9% p95_latency=210ms token_cost=+3% (baseline 205ms). smoke_v2 quality delta=+0.2% (ok). continuing to 0.25 in 8m.

mira: holding notes: chart pinned in release doc. rolling release notes to #release-notes after final gate. notify support and onsite SRE.

samir: if anything flaps, I'll set fast-drain and pin routing back. otherwise will promote at 30m. :eyes:

evan: pinging infra for extra autoscale headroom at +15m just in case.

mira: perfect. if we see p50 regress >15% we pause and triage. otherwise proceeding. deploybot: schedule promote to 1.0 at 00:35 UTC unless stopped.
